explanation: Exponential change multiplies by the same factor b every step (unlike linear change, which adds). When b > 1 the curve shoots up (growth); when 0 < b < 1 it decays toward zero. a is the starting value at x = 0. Notice how a small change in b dramatically changes how fast it rises.
bullets: Each unit of x multiplies y by b (constant ratio, not constant difference).
b > 1 grows; 0 < b < 1 decays; a is the value at x = 0.
Growth eventually outpaces ANY straight line.
